observation.command: cd /workspace && docker exec -i sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -t -c "SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('graphile_worker','iam','public');" 2>&1; echo "=== migrations creating graphile/schema ==="; grep -rln 'CREATE SCHEMA\|graphile' packages/data/migrations/*.sql | head; echo "=== goose status ==="; PGPASSWORD=sva_local_dev_password artifacts/tools/goose/v3.26.0/linux-x86_64/goose -dir packages/data/migrations status "postgres://sva@127.0.0.1:5432/sva_studio?sslmode=disable" 2>&1 | tail -5
